model.name: Epson Label Boost for ColorWorks Printers

faqs.question: Which label apps are supported by the software?
faqs.answer:
Epson Label Boost is designed to work with any ZPL-based label software. The following list of applications have been tested and are compatible with Epson Label Boost.
FedEx Ship Manager
UPS WorldShip
ShipStation
Stamps.com

faqs.question: How many printers can I use with one software license?
faqs.answer: The software license applies to one computer. Although you may connect multiple printers to the same computer, the software will only print to one printer.

faqs.question: How do I select the printer in the software?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Select
File
>
Printer Settings
to select the Epson ColorWorks printer driver.
Select your printer in the Printer drop-down list and click
OK
. You can also enter the Label Length, Label Width, and Printer Resolution settings.
Note:
Only Epson ColorWorks printers are supported.
Click
OK
.

faqs.question: Can I print more than one coupon on a shipping label?
faqs.answer: Yes. The software will support up to two coupons above and below the shipping label. You just need to make sure you have the appropriate size label.

faqs.question: Can I use the software to design custom coupons or promotional material?
faqs.answer:
You can use the software to add content to labels, but it’s not a tool for designing branded content. We recommend you use your existing marketing tools to design your branded content and then import the design into Epson Label Boost. If you are looking to create simple labels that are not custom branded, the software includes a small library of common secondary labels, such as “Fragile” and “This side up”.
Note:
Images must be in PNG format. For expected results, use an image that is equal to or less than the label width and matches your printer DPI settings. For example: 4" x 2" image at 200 DPI (800px by 400px).

faqs.question: What are the requirements to use Epson Label Boost?
faqs.answer:
See below.
Printers
Epson ColorWorks CW-C4000 Series
Epson ColorWorks CW-C6000 Series
Epson ColorWorks CW-C6500 Series
Operating Systems
Windows 11 Professional
Windows 11 Enterprise
Windows 10 Professional
Windows 10 Enterprise
Note:
64-bit versions are supported (version 22H2 or higher).
System Requirements
Intel Core i5 8th Generation Processor at 2GHz or higher
8GB DDR4 RAM
1GB free HDD space
Access
Administrator rights are required to install and set up the software.
Port 9100 available to intercept print jobs

Note:
Epson Label Boost is compatible with ZPL-based shipping label software.

UPS WorldShip
ShipStation
Stamps.com

faqs.question: How do I install Epson Label Boost?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Install the Epson ColorWorks printer driver prior to the label Boost installation.
Download the Epson Label Boost software. You can download the software from the Downloads tab on the Epson Label Boost product page.
Right-click and run as Administrator. The installer welcome screen appears.
Note:
Enter the administrator credentials if prompted.
Click
Next
. The Select Installation Folder window appears.
Do one of the following:
Click
Next
to install the software in the default folder.
Click
Browse
, select a different installation folder, then click
Next
to install the software.
Note:
The Disk Cost button can be used to confirm if you have available space in the local disk drives.
Click
Next
again to confirm the installation. When the installation is complete, the following screen appears.
Click
Close
. Epson Label Boost is now installed.

faqs.question: Can I print on label types other than shipping labels?
faqs.answer: The software is designed specifically for shipping labels, however, it should work with any label in a ZPL format.

faqs.question: The software failed to install. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Make sure a driver is installed for a supported Epson ColorWorks printer, otherwise, the software will not be installed. We recommend you print a test label from your shipping label software after you install the ColorWorks printer driver to ensure the driver is functioning properly before you install and set up Epson Label Boost.

faqs.question: Does the software work with all Epson ColorWorks printers?
faqs.answer: The software is compatible with the Epson ColorWorks CW-C4000, CW-C6000, and CW-C6500 series printers.
